verification_notes: An initial lint invocation overlapped Playwright test-results cleanup and failed with ENOENT. The sequential final lint passed.
The retained-capture browser regression uses the existing release e2e_server; its SHA-256 is recorded. Rust sources and protocols are unchanged.
The page accounting bound remains 32 MiB/128 pages, with a conservative new estimator. It is not an actual browser heap limit.
